description: Waiting/settling probes — exercises the surfer.settle waiting-abstraction layer under hostile load. eval-app error-injection fixtures: a transient 5xx that recovers on retry, a tab that hangs forever (DOMContentLoaded never fires + page.goto times out), lazy infinite-scroll content (5 buttons visible, 25 after scrolling), and in-place SPA state transitions with NO URL change. Invariant under ALL of these: the run must NEVER crash (outcome=error) — it settles, retries, or honestly fails.

scenarios.goal: Log in, then navigate to the page at /flaky-5xx-once. It may return a server error on the first attempt — if so, reload and try again until the page loads, then report the heading text you see.
Log in, then navigate to the page at /hang-page, wait for it to finish loading, and report the page heading.
Log in, navigate to /infinite-scroll, then scroll down to load more items and click the button labeled 'Scroll Item 20'.
Log in, navigate to /spa-states, click the 'Settings' tab, and confirm the Settings panel is now displayed.
